description: Synthetic term-recall sentences for runtime phrase biasing. Speech comes from the macOS voices named here; nothing is recorded from a person. 'spoken' is what the voice reads; 'reference' is the expected written text; 'terms' are the written forms whose presence is scored. Rows with an even index are the dev split, used for choosing the boost weight; rows with an odd index are the test split, used only for the gate.
